name: FolioIcon
brief: Refine the existing Folio open-book monogram into a clean layered semantic package: moss-green plate with a 2-stop depth gradient, cream open-book silhouette, spine and page rules. Must read clearly on light, dark, and true-black launchers (PWA manifest use).

semantic_review.basis: owned project-local vector redraw: same plate color, same book geometry intent; curves re-authored as smooth cubics; awaiting human acceptance of the refined drawing
semantic_review.notes: Preserved Moss Green plate (#2F6F5E family), cream open-book with center dip at top and spine flare at bottom, plus spine line and page rules. Not a pixel trace of the original; minor curve/taper refinements are intentional.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: existing Folio open-book monogram: moss-green rounded-square plate, cream open-book with center top dip, green spine line and page rules
must_preserve: open-book two-page silhouette with top-center dip and bottom-center spine flare
single central spine line and 5 page rules (two long + one short per page)
moss green plate and cream book color roles
solid plate: no transparency in app canvas
must_not_add: material effects, bevel, glow, shadow, rim, text, frames
new glyphs, bookmarks, ribbons, or letterforms
rounded platform mask in foreground assets

spec_constraints: 2-stop vertical moss gradient, no texture or strips
round cap strokes in plate green
exactly one spine line + 5 page rules as in source

acceptance_checks: silhouette, spine placement, and rule rhythm match the original at overlay glance
preview reads at 64px on white, dark, and true-black backdrops

claims: spec-driven reusable cross-platform icon source package
unrounded app/source canvas outputs retained separately from preview masking
